findings.scenario: mid-restore purge-ledger append (the reconciliation TOCTOU): the destination's ledger is read once BEFORE the insert transaction; a row appended after that read and before the commit is never honored
findings.evidence: deterministic probe on a clean migrated scratch DST: arv.note held under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock so the restore's insert phase blocked past its ledger read; a ledger row (A,note,<nid>,'mid-restore purge') inserted as arv_app during the block; lock released -> the restore committed rc=0 printing ledger_as_of=empty with the note fully present (2 revisions) AND the ledger row present — a permanent ledger-says-purged/content-present state with no re-reconciliation path (a second restore is refused ARV-EXP-002). notverified.txt names the EXPORT-side read-committed limit but is silent on this restore-side race (a LAW-04 gap). Today the only ledger writers are direct substrate inserts, but D-011's governed purge command will make the race owner-reachable
findings.status_note: fix before merge: re-read the ledger inside the insert transaction (or hold a lock on arv.purge_ledger across it), or land the named limit in notverified.txt routed to D-011's integration slice

findings.scenario: the docstring's claimed ledger merge is not implemented: export.py states 'the archive's own ledger rows merge ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (the destination's current entries stay authoritative)' but the insert phase emits a plain INSERT for purge_ledger
findings.evidence: probe: an archive exported from an SRC carrying a purge_ledger row restored into a clean DST (the row lands, rc=0), then the SAME archive restored into a DST pre-seeded with the same (A,note,<nid>) ledger row -> rc=1, 'FAIL ARV-EXP-003: the insert phase failed ... ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint purge_ledger_pkey', zero rows, the destination's ledger intact. Fail-closed (no corruption, no resurrection) but the declared merge behavior is false and the refusal mislabels a well-formed archive under the malformed/tamper code ARV-EXP-003
findings.status_note: fix before merge: add ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING to the purge_ledger inserts (the destination's entries stay authoritative) or correct the docstring

findings.scenario: ledger kinds beyond the card's declared drop rules: a purged highlight/bookmark/anchor/work drops only the entity's own rows; a surviving note_reference pointing at the purged entity is not reconciled away

findings.status_note: routed: the purge-cascade semantics (dropping inbound references or the referencing notes) belong to the governed-purge family D-011; revisit when the purge command lands — the current behavior is safe but coarse

review_summary: The slice's core single-threaded claims HOLD under adversarial re-verification on fresh scratch databases: the 13-table export/restore equality through the independent arv_read role is byte-exact; the destination-ledger reconciliation drops the ledgered note's every row and the ledgered source's whole capture tree while work/command_log/outbox restore intact (SYS-10); the dropped-ledger destination fails closed with the typed ARV-EXP-006; the tampered manifest and the missing blob refuse with zero rows; the pre-commit crash leaves nothing and the re-run completes; the append-only ARV-PRG-001 ledger is RLS-forced and owner-isolated; a cross-owner manifest implant is refused by RLS; EXP-01..10 exit 0 at HEAD and the LAW-05 red binding (f6cf5fb, schema 2, the amendment chain) verifies. TWO P1s block the merge: (F1) a demonstrated TOCTOU — a purge-ledger row appended to the destination between the restore's ledger read and its commit is silently overridden, leaving a permanent purged-but-present state with no re-reconciliation path (a SYS-10 permanence hole the honest-limits file does not name); (F2) the docstring's claimed ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING ledger merge is not implemented — the overlapping-ledger restore fails closed under a mislabeled ARV-EXP-003 instead of merging. Three P2s are routed with reasons: the coarse whole-archive refusal on non-tree ledger kinds (F3), the integrity-not-authenticity limit of the state hash (F4), and the command_log-proxy clean-destination gate (F5).
